summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Production Overtime module with new break time handling and tiered multiplier calculations. All backend API endpoints and frontend UI components verified successfully.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/production/overtime-rules returns new fields (weekday_break_start/end, holiday_break_start/end, sat_hol_tier1_hours)
Backend: PUT /api/production/overtime-rules persists new fields correctly
Backend: SUNDAY 08:00-16:00 => ot_hours=7 (break 12-13 excluded), day_label='Minggu/Libur', weighted=14 (7x2)
Backend: National holiday on SATURDAY 08:00-16:00 => ot_hours=7, day_type='holiday_saturday', weighted=17 (5x2 + 1x3 + 1x4)
Backend: Manual hours entry uses ot_hours directly with no break deduction
Frontend: Overtime page loads correctly at /produksi/overtime
Frontend: Master Aturan Lembur modal opens successfully
Frontend: Jendela Istirahat section displays weekday break (18:00-19:00) and holiday break (12:00-13:00) fields
Frontend: Pengali Hari Kerja & Sabtu Biasa section displays multiplier fields (1.5x, 2x)
Frontend: Pengali Minggu/Libur Biasa section displays flat multiplier field (2x)
Frontend: Pengali Libur Nasional yang Jatuh di Sabtu section displays tiered multiplier fields (tier1=5, x2, x3, x4)
Frontend: Save functionality persists rule changes correctly
Frontend: Overtime records table displays all calculation columns (1.5x, 2x, 3x, 4x, weighted hours)
